about: The graduale of the formulary “Palm Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Thou hast held me by my right hand, and by Thy will Thou hast conducted me, and with glory Thou hast received me. How good God is to Israel, to the upright in heart! But my feet were almost moved, my steps had well-nigh slipped, because I was envious of sinners, seeing their peace.
